// Running scripts.
$ echo 'echo hello from $0 $1; whoami' > /tmp/s.sh; chmod +x /tmp/s.sh; /tmp/s.sh arg
hello from /tmp/s.sh arg
root
$ cd /tmp; ./s.sh
hello from ./s.sh
root
$ sh /tmp/s.sh x
hello from /tmp/s.sh x
root
$ bash -c 'echo inline $0 $1; exit 4' name one
inline name one
[exit 4]
$ echo 'echo piped' | sh
piped
$ echo 'exit 9' > /tmp/e.sh; sh /tmp/e.sh; echo $?
9
$ chmod -x /tmp/s.sh; /tmp/s.sh
-bash: /tmp/s.sh: Permission denied
[exit 126]
$ /tmp
-bash: /tmp: Is a directory
[exit 126]
$ /nope
-bash: /nope: No such file or directory
[exit 127]

// Recursion is bounded.
$ echo 'sh /tmp/r.sh' > /tmp/r.sh; sh /tmp/r.sh 2>&1 | tail -1
-bash: /tmp/r.sh: maximum nesting level exceeded

// Dropped binaries crash; stock ones run.
$ printf '\177ELFbinary' > /tmp/bot; chmod +x /tmp/bot; /tmp/bot -c 1
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
[exit 139]
$ /usr/bin/whoami
root
$ /bin/echo via path
via path
$ rm /usr/bin/ls; ls
ls: command not found
[exit 127]
